title: Business Credit Cards Are Going to Give Much Better Bonuses & Points Earn Due to RBA Reforms eg AmEx 190,000 Points
body:
The RBA reforms taking effect on 1 October 2026 are lowering wholesale interchange fee caps. For consumer credit cards, the cap drops from 0.8% to 0.3%, whereas business credit card caps remain unchanged at 0.8%. Consequently, while consumer cards are likely to see reduced points earning rates and smaller sign-up bonus offers, business card rewards may remain unaffected. American Express is also unaffected by these interchange caps.
The best bonus points offers now are on business cards such as:
NAB Qantas Business Visa Signature Card: 150,000 bonus Qantas points & 0.66 per $1 points earning - https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/933192
AmEx Qantas Business Rewards Card: 190,000 bonus Qantas points + $200 travel credit & 1.25 per $1 points earning - https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/965731
